CFB:cfb.ol.source_or_reason: Line quality is PFF-grade/depth-chart based; depth charts only via scraping, PFF paid. CFBD lacks OL starters/grades.

CFB:cfb.in_game_exit_risk.source_or_reason: No public structured record of in-game injury exits; ESPN play text only sporadically notes injuries.

CFB:cfb.defender_production_profile.source_or_reason: CFBD player stats API (tackles, sacks, QB hurries) permitted only with owner-registered key; snap/pass-rush usage not public.

NBA:nba.def_scheme.source_or_reason: Drop/switch/blitz/zone play-type frequencies are Synergy (paid); stats.nba.com synergy endpoints not a permitted source.

NBA:nba.reb_chances.source_or_reason: Rebound chances/contested rebounds are NBA tracking data from stats.nba.com (undocumented, not on permitted list).

NBA:nba.tracking.source_or_reason: Tracking/hustle data via stats.nba.com or PBPStats; not a permitted source and only partial history.

NBA:nba.opp_three_openness_allowed.source_or_reason: Open/wide-open three splits require tracking defender-distance (stats.nba.com); not permitted; ESPN has no defender distance.

NBA:nba.joint_pace_interaction.source_or_reason: Pace and slower-team weight derivable from team box scores in owner's NBA archive/ESPN ledgers; transition share part needs Synergy (excluded).

CBB:cbb.lineup_adj_rating.source_or_reason: Ratings from ESPN CBB box scores, but tonight's active set needs pregame availability; final lineups barred. ESPN injury feed accrues only prospectively.

CBB:cbb.defense_style.source_or_reason: Press/zone/pack-line frequencies are Synergy (paid) or BartTorvik/KenPom (scrape/paid); ESPN lacks style tags.

CBB:cbb.fouls_officials.source_or_reason: Fouls/FT computable from ESPN CBB box scores, but crew assignments are public only near tip; ESPN gives post-game officials; capture ESPN summary prospectively.

CBB:cbb.teammate_absence_shift.source_or_reason: With/without splits computed from ESPN CBB boxscore ledger; prior-game absences are fine. Tonight's absence status is a separate input.

CBB:cbb.handler_absence_pace_shift.source_or_reason: Handler identified from assists/usage in ESPN CBB boxscores; pace and efficiency with/without computed from ledger.

CBB:cbb.rebound_competition_on_floor.source_or_reason: ESPN CBB play-by-play (site.api.espn.com) gives sub events to reconstruct on-floor sets; heights from roster endpoint; history backfillable.

CBB:cbb.ball_handler_succession_map.source_or_reason: Succession inferred from assist/usage shares when handler absent in ESPN CBB boxscore ledger; coarse without tracking.

CBB:cbb.assisted_three_dependency.source_or_reason: ESPN CBB pbp text ('Assisted by') on site.api.espn.com permitted; backfillable by game.

CBB:cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.source_or_reason: Past fields from Wikipedia (needs host approval); NET/rank vintage at selection not archived, retrieval-time ranks unusable.

CBB:cbb.kenpom_snapshot_timing_rules.source_or_reason: KenPom is a paid subscription; rules/snapshots not permitted.

NHL:nhl.officials.source_or_reason: NHL public JSON (api-web.nhle.com) gives game referees/linesmen and penalties; history backfillable. Tonight's crew only if posted pregame; as-played retrieval not pregame.

SOCCER:soc.pace_press.source_or_reason: Pressing/tempo needs event data; FBref/Opta/Understat not permitted; StatsBomb open data covers few competitions only.

needs: set-piece taker and aerial duel data
SOCCER:soc.set_pieces.source_or_reason: Takers/aerial strength from FBref/Transfermarkt/Opta (not permitted); StatsBomb open data partial only.

needs: transfer and manager-change lists with dates
SOCCER:soc.transfers.source_or_reason: Wikipedia/MediaWiki season transfer and manager lists (CC BY-SA) need owner approval of host; revision history gives dating.

SOCCER:soc.xg_adjusted_ratings.source_or_reason: League xG is Understat/FBref (not permitted); StatsBomb open data too narrow. Shots/SoT proxy from football-data.co.uk is not xG.

SOCCER:soc.rotation_index.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer summaries (lineups) plus football-data.co.uk/openfootball fixtures; prior-match XIs backfillable; tonight's XI is not pregame-safe far ahead.

SOCCER:soc.added_time.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer commentary/key events for stoppage time; football-data.co.uk referee column; pregame referee appointments not archived.

SOCCER:soc.open_game_index.source_or_reason: football-data.co.uk results (CSV, open) give BTTS/clean sheets; full backfill.

SOCCER:soc.cup_progression_load.source_or_reason: openfootball plus ESPN schedules for domestic and cup fixtures; backfillable; European coverage via openfootball partial.

SOCCER:soc.leader_race_state.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer boxscores/openfootball for scorers, fixtures; minutes from lineups; backfillable.

SOCCER:soc.award_voting_narrative.source_or_reason: Wikipedia pages hold outcomes only; narrative/voting coupling is largely unstructured. Needs Wikipedia host approval.

needs: player shots and SoT per match
SOCCER:soc.player_shot_share.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer player match stats include shots/SoT; backfillable via ESPN public JSON.

SOCCER:soc.team_fail_to_score_propensity.source_or_reason: football-data.co.uk results CSVs, multi-season; trivially backfilled.

SOCCER:soc.shared_shock_overlap.source_or_reason: Fixture load permitted, but historical injury exposure comes from Transfermarkt (not permitted); no open injury archive.

needs: goal events with type (penalty, own goal, set piece)
SOCCER:soc.first_goal_route_mix.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer key events tag penalty/own goal; set-piece route needs commentary parsing; StatsBomb open for subset.

SOCCER:soc.team_goal_share_competition.source_or_reason: npxG is Understat/FBref (not permitted); StatsBomb open data limited coverage.

SOCCER:soc.xi_attack_defence_split.source_or_reason: Player valuations/ratings come from Transfermarkt/Opta/FBref (not permitted); no open equivalent.

needs: event data with crosses and zones
SOCCER:soc.cross_and_wide_play_share.source_or_reason: Needs event data (Opta/FBref); StatsBomb open data covers only selected competitions.

SOCCER:soc.first_goalscorer_race_model.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer key events and lineups for scorers, sub minutes; backfillable; model is derived, not market.

SOCCER:soc.shot_event_definition_mapping.source_or_reason: Definitions from StatsBomb open-data spec (GitHub) and ESPN field docs/samples; documentation mapping, not time series.

SOCCER:soc.player_tournament_match_expos.source_or_reason: openfootball worldcup/euro data plus ESPN/StatsBomb open for minutes; backfillable for past tournaments.

SOCCER:soc.shootout_length_distribution.source_or_reason: openfootball and open international-results CSVs (shootouts) plus StatsBomb open kicks; Wikipedia for older ones; backfillable.

SOCCER:soc.tournament_player_scoring_poo.source_or_reason: Goals from openfootball/StatsBomb open; club attribution requires Wikipedia squad pages (host approval needed).

SOCCER:soc.late_level_risk_appetite.source_or_reason: ESPN commentary/key events and StatsBomb open events give score-state-by-minute; limited samples for knockouts.

SOCCER:soc.pair_onpitch_overlap_model.source_or_reason: ESPN soccer lineup/substitution events for historical on-pitch overlap; backfillable.

TENNIS:ten.in_play.source_or_reason: Only ESPN public tennis scoreboard JSON offers live state; ATP/WTA live scoring is scrape-only. History accrues by capture; Sackmann charting covers few matches.

TENNIS:ten.double_fault_pressure.source_or_reason: Sackmann Match Charting Project (CC) point data plus match stats BP faced/DF; limited match coverage, small samples.

TENNIS:ten.ball_change_cycle.source_or_reason: Ball age derived from game counts in Sackmann scores and standard 7/9-game rule; per-tournament protocols not public.

TENNIS:ten.exhibition_format_effort.source_or_reason: Exhibitions not in Sackmann tour files; Wikipedia event pages need host approval; effort proxy is sparse.

TENNIS:ten.game_serial_dependence.source_or_reason: Game-by-game results derivable from score strings in Sackmann match files already in owner's archive.
